inspiration: Additive glow surfaces: fire and glow materials are flagged additive and blended with pure add so black texels vanish (crates/eqoxide-assets/src/lib.rs:22; crates/eqoxide-renderer/src/pipeline.rs:507). Recreate as additive passes for torches, forges and magic.
Animated surfaces: a material carries a millisecond interval and a frame list (eqAnim, crates/eqoxide-assets/src/lib.rs:37). Good for flicker, water and portal shimmer without custom shader code.

Foliage cutout: alpha test at half alpha (MASK_ALPHA_CUTOFF_U8 = 128, lib.rs:58) plus a corner-colour key fallback for textures baked without one (lib.rs:64-67, 92). Make the background-key step explicit in our texture pipeline.

Armour as region variants: material names encode region, material and variant (docs/equipment-textures-findings.md, GLB primitive and material name sections). Full body is covered by disjoint pieces, not overlapping alternates.
Held weapons are separate per-item models drawn at a hand bone rather than baked into the body (crates/eqoxide-renderer/src/gpu.rs:49).
Per-clip grounding: a skinned humanoid is scaled to a target height and re-grounded from the current animation clip bounds (docs/character-models.md, Normalization section).
Race size by a height rule, not by eye (README.md:39 relative race sizes). Use our own size table when designing size classes.

briefs.change: our own cooler ember ramp; different frame count; halo instead of flat sprite

briefs.keep: alpha-test cutout at 0.5; corner-key background removal at bake time
briefs.change: our own leaf shape language; two-colour ramp per tree; sway on the top only
